scripts.sync-version: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const packagePath='./package.json';const pkg=require(packagePath);const match=/^(.*)\\+(\\d+)$/.exec(pkg.version);if(!match)throw new Error('Version must end with +<build number>');pkg.version=match[1]+'+'+(Number(match[2])+1);fs.writeFileSync(packagePath,JSON.stringify(pkg,null,2)+'\\n');fs.writeFileSync('version.js','window.SNES_XDC_APP_VERSION = '+JSON.stringify(pkg.version)+';\\n');"
scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && npm run sync-version && bestzip dist/snes-xdc-$(node -p "require('./package.json').version.replace('+', '.')").xdc manifest.toml index.html emulatorjs/** icon.png game.sfc
